criteria.description: Returns exactly the six requested fields and the severe coseismic surface-change label.
criteria.name: Requested JSON and final label
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the correct label with schema issues, or a correct schema with a wrong label.

criteria.description: Computes max PGA times finite-fault maximum slip as about 10.064 and treats the gate as passing.
criteria.name: Ground-motion/slip calculation
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for using only one component, using imprecise rounding, or omitting the gate state.

criteria.description: Computes radar_mean_db divided by radar_std_db as about -0.610 and verifies positive before/after counts.
criteria.name: Radar normalized change
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for finding the negative radar mean without the normalized value or count gate.

criteria.description: Computes the annual embedding max-to-mean ratio as about 35.463 and applies both localized-outlier thresholds.
criteria.name: Embedding outlier concentration
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for recognizing localized outliers without the ratio or threshold check.

criteria.description: Uses the largest event-date precipitation mean, about 0.349 mm, to pass the dry-weather gate.
criteria.name: Dry-weather screen
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for identifying low precipitation without using the maximum mean estimate.

criteria.description: Computes the liquefaction-to-landslide population exposure ratio as about 186.842 and checks the red alert.
criteria.name: Ground-failure exposure contrast
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for naming liquefaction as larger without the ratio or alert check.

criteria.description: Interprets the passing gates as coseismic surface change and avoids unsupported realized-loss inferences.
criteria.name: Bounded numeric interpretation
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point if the interpretation is mostly correct but overstates one uncomputed impact.
